response: {"texts":[{"id":"DMSR-7022","text":"High-volume queries on the Object table – queries that involve full-sky scans – shall be answered in hvObjectQueryTime."},{"id":"DMSR-6775","text":"Complex high-volume queries -– queries that involve full-sky spatial and temporal correlations – shall be answered in less than hvComplexQueryTime."},{"id":"DMSR-8069","text":"The system shall support hvQueryUsers simultaneous high-volume queries running at any given time."},{"id":"DMSR-7054","text":"Low volume queries, queries that are spatially restricted to a circle of radius lvSkyRadius and return at most lvMaxReturnedResults of data, shall respond within lvQueryTime under a load of lvQueryUsers simultaneous queries."},{"id":"DMSR-6225","text":"The live Prompt Products Database shall support at least l1QueryUsers simultaneous queries, assuming each query lasts no more than l1QueryTime."},{"id":"DMSR-2570","text":"The DM copy of the EFD shall support at least dmEfdQueryUsers simultaneous queries, assuming each query lasts no more than dmEfdQueryTime."},{"id":"DMSR-6644","text":"All the enclosed performance metrics shall be met simultaneously."}]}
